subject: maths
question: What equal instalment of annual payment (in ₹) will discharge a debt that is due as ₹624 at the end of 5 years at 2% per annum simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Total debt = ₹624

Time = 5 years

Rate of interest = 2% per annum

**Formula used:**

Total amount = P (first year) + (P + 0.02P) (Second year) + (P + 0.04P) (third year) + (P + 0.06P) (fourth year) + (P + 0.08P) (fifth year).

**Calculation:**

Total amount = 5P + 0.2P = 5.2P

⇒ 5.2P = 624

⇒ P = 624 / 5.2 = 120

**∴ The equal annual installment is ₹120.**
